subject: Vendr portal: scoped profile verification & presigned upload gating
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Jill Ramos <jill@vendr.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-12T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Vendr portal: scoped profile verification & presigned upload gating

Jill —

Thanks for taking this. We're preparing a minimal SIG/SOC2 evidence bundle for an upcoming customer audit and want to avoid a full portal ingest if possible. Can you confirm whether Vendr supports: 1) a scoped profile where we mark specific controls as "provided proof" only for the SIG subset the customer needs, and 2) S3 presigned uploads (or equivalent API) so we can push a single ZIP without adding contributor users?

If presigned uploads are fine, we'll plan to tag artifacts with a prefix and hand off an owner map (CSV) that indicates which Redwood owner each file maps to for attestation. Attached is a draft owner_map.csv so you can see the format.

Target timeline: audit window starts 2027-04-20, so a short turnaround on provisioning/upload would be helpful.

Thanks — I can be the portal contact for anything that requires a Redwood admin.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Security Programs Manager | Redwood Inference

From: Jill Ramos <jill@vendr.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: security@vendr.com
Date: 2027-04-12T12:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendr portal: scoped profile verification & presigned upload gating

Hi Karthik —

Short answer: yes to both, with a few caveats. We can create a profile that's scoped to only the SIG controls you need and mark items as "provided by vendor" vs. "customer validated." For uploads we support: (a) portal UI with an "upload-only contributor" role, (b) S3 presigned PUTs into a short-lived ingest bucket, or (c) our ingestion API.

If you want the presigned flow, we need the upload prefix and confirmation that files will be signed/proofed per your owner map. Presigned uploads have a TTL (configurable) and a max object size (we default to 1GB).

I'll attach our portal role instructions (PDF) and a manifest template so your team can match metadata to our expected fields. When you're ready share the owner map CSV and preferred tag prefix; we can generate presigned URLs and a short access window.

Portal link: https://vendr.vendor-portal.com/portal/abc123

—Jill Ramos
Vendor Security Lead, Vendr
(attachment: portal_role_instructions.pdf)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-13T08:05:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Vendr portal: scoped profile verification & presigned upload gating

Ben / Soojin —

Jill confirmed they can do a scoped SIG profile and presigned S3 uploads. She's flagged default limits (1GB/object, TTL configurable). I'm going to hand the upload coordination to Soojin if that's ok — Soojin can you take the owner_map CSV and the manifest template, and coordinate the presign request with Vendr? Ben, once uploads are staged can you do a quick attestation that items map to the controls we've listed?

Goal: complete ingest + attestation by 2027-04-19 to give us a day buffer before the audit.

—Karthik

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Jill Ramos <jill@vendr.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-14T10:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendr portal: scoped profile verification & presigned upload gating

Jill —

Thanks — copying the relevant excerpt from your earlier note for visibility:

"We can create a profile that's scoped to only the SIG controls you need and mark items as 'provided by vendor' vs. 'customer validated.' For uploads we support: (a) portal UI with an 'upload-only contributor' role, (b) S3 presigned PUTs into a short-lived ingest bucket, or (c) our ingestion API."

We'll go with S3 presigned PUTs. A couple of questions before you generate URLs:
- TTL: can you confirm the exact TTL you plan to use (we prefer 72 hours but will accept 48 if that's a policy requirement)
- Max size: confirm 1GB/object default vs. being able to override for the ZIP (our ZIP will be ~850MB)
- Prefix: we'll use redwood-inference/2027-04-sig/ as the prefix for the batch

Attached is a copy of our S3 upload policy for the ingest bucket (redwood-s3-policy.json). We'll stage uploads to the prefix and provide the upload_manifest_template.csv with file-level metadata. Ben, I'll flag anything that needs your signed attestation once upload completes.

Thanks — aiming to upload today if we get presigns.

—Soojin
Soojin Lee
Security Operations | Redwood Inference
(attachment: redwood-s3-policy.json)

From: Jill Ramos <jill@vendr.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: security@vendr.com
Date: 2027-04-14T16:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendr portal: scoped profile verification & presigned upload gating

Soojin —

All set. Generated presigned PUTs for prefix redwood-inference/2027-04-sig/. TTL: 72 hours. Max object size: 1GB (we can make an exception to 1.2GB if you need it for a single ZIP, but we prefer ZIPs under 1GB). Please include upload_manifest_template.csv as the final manifest.

I've also created an "Upload Contributor" role for your account that only allows creating objects in the ingest prefix; no portal admin privileges. Portal instructions attached and I've included a sample manifest (upload_manifest_template.csv). I'll mark this ingestion as priority and will flag the profile as a "minimal SIG subset" so reviewers only focus on requested controls.

Portal: https://vendr.vendor-portal.com/portal/abc123

If you upload today I can validate and move proofs into the profile by tomorrow morning.

—Jill Ramos
Vendor Security Lead, Vendr
(attachment: upload_manifest_template.csv)
